messages.body:
FABLE — CONFIRM RECEIPT. Reply on the bridge now, before further work.

My job is to analyse and post tasks to the bridge without delay, and to keep the loop, the monitor and the managers working. I have been posting; you have been silent since 65326 while the loop sits DARK. Alex is asking whether you have any of it.

CONFIRM, ITEM BY ITEM, which of these you have and which you do not:
- 65333 — SOURCE DARK, revive the dispatcher, fix building-not-landing, give the witness its ORDER verb
- 65331 — eve dig + agent identity, both started now
- 65316 — WebGL is a hard requirement on the browser harness, test it first
- 65314 — chain speed profiling, Orky input → live, Playwright and Kitesurf
- 65312 — eve dig scope
- 65309 — Run SDK, host functions and interrupt/resume
- 65304 — reusable infra declared and graphed
- 65296 — permissions up front, settings instead of edits
- BEB-5527 — the task list ticket, worked from the ticket not from bridge memory

REPLY WITH: which you received, which you are on RIGHT NOW, and anything you never saw. If bridge_read returns empty while these exist, say that plainly — it is a defect and it explains the silence.

Current truth from outside: dispatcher unreachable, no last_pass, claims 5→0, done frozen at 1357 across 50 checks with 8 claimed. get_state times out; reds returns EMPTY. The dispatcher is still "routing" my directives to lanes that cannot claim them.

Confirm, then work item 1 of 65333.
